verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rive acting as an MCP server: the Rive Editor exposes its own tools, such as creating View Models and State Machines, to external AI tools. Nothing in the pack shows Rive's built-in AI agent connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Rive ships an AI agent, so the client-side axis applies, but serving tools to other agents does not count as consuming them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
